# 1.21.4 DimLib test dependency

`dimlib-source` was copied from the iPortalTeam DimLib repository's `1.21.3` branch (commit `467e83b`) and adapted locally to Minecraft 1.21.4 with Fabric API `0.119.4+1.21.4`. The upstream source and its Apache 2.0 `LICENSE` are included. The Fabric metadata now matches that license. `dimlib-1.1.0+mc1.21.4.jar` is the resulting local test build (SHA-256 `47D785217E1EA0BE868E8327751B95F19AF7D627D35894D35A3B447BC15809A5`).

This is an interim dependency for the Fabric port; it is not an upstream DimLib release. Changes to the source require rebuilding the JAR and updating the hash before release.
